pages.title: Light Sail
pages.text: A sail of aluminised film a few microns thick, pushed by nothing but the pressure of starlight. Unfurl it high above the world, where there is no air left to drag on it, and it carries you out to the Accretion Frontier.
Made in a crafting grid.$(br2)$(thing)Found in$(): Derelict Station chests.$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): Resonant Circuits.
